subject: ADR-171: figure provenance -- read-report says where each number was read from, and the readable audit credits every channel the reader has
body: THE READABLE-FIGURES AUDIT DISAGREED WITH THE READER IT MEASURES. ADR-146's audit_readable was careful not to hold a second copy of read-report's naming rule -- READABLE is what the reader itself returned -- but it asked the reader for its boxes, tables and charts and NOT its labelled figures, the .v/.l pairs the figures channel keys by LABEL. A figure read under its label from an element whose id is not named like a box was counted as one no task could read. THIRTEEN of the kit's 22 blind figures were exactly that (the visualizer's mH/mN/mOpt/mRot, the notebook's mrC/mrM/mrR, the proofs' six splay-potential stats), and the tree-visualizer task has asserted output.by.singleWrap.Height since ADR-128: read AND held, and the audit said no task could see it. Four more, the visualizer's comparison cards cc-AVL/RB/Splay/WB, sit inside #cmpGrid, which IS a box; their numbers were in boxes.cmpGrid all along, and the audit, counting at the deepest id, never looked up the chain. The instrument accusing working code -- ADR-109's shape again. WHAT CHANGED: read-report returns `sources` beside `figures`, keyed the same way -- the id of the .v each figure was read from when it has one, else the pair's id, else the box; additive, nothing existing moves. The audit's READABLE is now boxes, table and chart hosts, the figures' sources, AND elements read THROUGH the box around them -- the last only when the box's RETURNED text, capped at 4000 characters as the reader returns it, carries the element's text whole: held against the returned text and not the DOM, because a card past the cap or longer than it is in the DOM and not in the report, and crediting it would be the audit trusting the DOM over the reader. The through-a-box reading is the weakest (a substring of a blob, not a keyed value), so the ledger names it per element. WRITTEN now requires text: the greenhouse's srcExtra is an entry host that is EMPTY once a source with no settings is picked. *Board joins the box naming (the pheno tracker's momBoard and rankBoard -- the ranked run was invisible twice over, not named like a box and skipped by the audit as an entry host because each row carries buttons); the mutation anchor on that regex line is widened with it, ADR-140's lesson. Three declared furniture with reasons: field-season's dayLabel repeats the days-left tile (total - day + 1), its seasonTag repeats the seed the setup control holds and the results box prints, cp-characters' genCards is reference prose painted at boot from the key's own table. The tree-visualizer task enters compare mode after the four morphs and holds boxes.cmpGrid to the four cards whole -- the same heights, node counts and rotations the morphs already hold against verify_tv's Python port, read a second way -- then leaves it and reads the single tree unchanged: 91 -> 98 confirmed. FIGURES READABLE 248 OF 270 -> 268 OF 268, 0 blind (was 22 on 7 pages), every ceiling 0. verify_report 109 -> 114, mutate_report 64 -> 68/68; verify_readable 28 -> 33, mutate_readable 23 -> 30/30. Held: sources is keyed like figures, never empty, never coarser than by (three mutants, one per rung); only the four comparison cards are read through a box anywhere in the kit; rankBoard is read as a box now but the audit still skips it as an entry host, so a figure with a button inside it is still not counted as written -- ADR-146's known hole, unchanged. Also: the push script's session line now names the session that generated it -- a handoff to a new session is not a hand edit, so deliver.py --check accepts every trailer a real slice was signed with, coauthor AND session -- and that turned up mutate_delivery's stale anchor: 'a hand-edited script is not compared' had anchored on a line ADR-155 rewrote and the ledger still said killed from the run before; re-anchored, 30/30. No page was edited.
